controles.affirmation: Aucun litige de propriete intellectuelle materiel en cours contre la societe
controles.verbatim_source: We are not currently a party to any material pending legal proceeding; however, from time to time, we may become involved in legal proceedings or be subject to claims arising in the ordinary course of our business. (10-Q T2 2026, Item 1 Legal Proceedings)

controles.affirmation: Programme de restructuration lance au T2 2026 avec environ 3,3 M$ de charges liees a une reduction d'effectifs
controles.verbatim_source: In the second quarter of 2026, we initiated a restructuring program to reduce overall operating expenses and improve future profitability. In connection with the program, we recorded approximately $3.3 million of restructuring charges related to workforce reduction. The restructuring program was substantially completed in the second quarter of 2026. (10-Q T2 2026)

controles.affirmation: Marge operationnelle GAAP 35% au T2 2026 contre 37% au T2 2025 ; non-GAAP 45% contre 46% ; CA record 207,4 M$ +20%
controles.verbatim_source: Operating margin 35% / 37% (GAAP) et 45% / 46% (non-GAAP) ; Record quarterly revenue of $207.4 million, up 20% year over year (8-K 27/07/2026, ex-99.1). Le 10-Q donne le detail non arrondi : Operating income 35.0% / 36.6%.
controles.correction_proposee: Aucune correction obligatoire : 37% est le chiffre arrondi publie par la societe elle-meme. A noter que le recul reel est de 1,6 pt (36,6 -> 35,0) et non de 2 pts.

controles.affirmation: SG&A 38,262 M$ au T2 2026 contre 28,115 M$ (+36%), dont 7,0 M$ de frais professionnels supplementaires
controles.verbatim_source: Total sales, general and administrative expenses for the three months ended June 30, 2026 increased approximately $10.2 million as compared to the same period in 2025, due to increases in professional fees of $7.0 million, payroll-related expenses of $1.5 million and stock-based compensation expenses of $1.0 million. (10-Q T2 2026) ; compte de resultat condense 38,262 / 28,115

controles.affirmation: Nombre immateriel d'actions rachetees au S1 2026, autorisation residuelle de 5,5 millions d'actions, ASR de 100 M$ annonce le 5 aout 2026, rachats annuels -94% en 2025
controles.verbatim_source: During the six months ended June 30, 2026, the Company repurchased an immaterial number of shares under the 2020 Repurchase Program [...] As of June 30, 2026, there remained an outstanding authorization to repurchase approximately 5.5 million shares (10-Q T2 2026) ; Rambus Initiates $100 Million Accelerated Share Repurchase Program, August 5, 2026 (8-K ex-99.1) ; buyback_annual FY2024 113,699 -> FY2025 7,114 soit -94% (kpis-haut/RMBS.json)

controles.affirmation: Les cinq premiers clients ont represente 66% du CA en 2025 contre 62% en 2024 et 2023 ; Client A 22% et Client B 16% du CA du T2 2026 contre 40% un an plus tot
controles.verbatim_source: Our top five customers represented 66% of our revenue in 2025 and 62% in both 2024 and 2023. (10-K FY2025) ; Customer A 22% / 22%, Customer B 16% / 18% (10-Q T2 2026, Note 7)

controles.affirmation: La part du CA realise hors des Etats-Unis est passee de 62% (2023) a 64% (2024) puis 82% (2025), 'un bond que la societe attribue a la structure de sa clientele'
controles.verbatim_source: Our revenue from companies headquartered outside of the United States accounted for 82% of total revenue in 2025 as compared to 64% in 2024 and 62% in 2023. We expect that revenue derived from international customers will continue to represent a significant portion of our total revenue in the future. (10-K FY2025, Item 1A). Aucune explication du bond n'est donnee : ni dans l'Item 1A, ni dans la Note 7, ni dans le MD&A.
controles.correction_proposee: Chiffres exacts, attribution a supprimer. Ecrire : 'la societe ne fournit aucune explication de ce bond de 18 points'.

controles.affirmation: La societe reconnait que ses clients et prospects pourraient adopter des technologies alternatives pour eviter les redevances
controles.verbatim_source: To the extent that alternative technologies might provide comparable system performance at lower or similar cost to our technologies, or are perceived to require the payment of no or lower fees and/or royalties [...] our customers and prospective customers may adopt and promote such alternative technologies. (10-K FY2025, Item 1A Risk Factors)
